extracted.intended_audience: individuals and organizations submitting or tracking petitions for national rulemaking to the U.S. EPA Office of Air and Radiation (e.g., advocacy groups, industry, state/local agencies, counsel, and members of the public).
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing which petitions the EPA Office of Air and Radiation posts online (and which it excludes), how petition entries are presented, and caveats about what posting signifies. The page is a public listing of petitions for generally applicable, national rulemakings received by OAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Posting timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: This page makes available petitions for rulemaking received by the Office of Air and Radiation on or after January 1, 2013.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only petitions received on or after the stated date are included on this specific page; earlier petitions are not represented here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of submissions posted (definition of 'petitions')
rubrics_metrics.description: For the purposes of this page, the agency has posted incoming communications styled as 'petitions' for generally applicable, national rulemakings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page focuses on communications explicitly styled as petitions that request generally applicable, national rulemaking — i.e., requests seeking national regulatory action rather than case-specific relief.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion — petitions submitted as docket comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions provided as comments in a publicly available rulemaking docket are not reproduced here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a petitioner submitted their petition as part of an existing rulemaking docket (i.e., as a comment), that submission will not be copied to this separate petitions list; users should consult the relevant rulemaking docket for such material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion — petitions for reconsideration of recently issued CAA rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for reconsideration of rules recently issued under the Clean Air Act are also not included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests that seek reconsideration of recently issued CAA rules are excluded from this listing; such petitions are handled differently and will not appear on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing fields / entry format
rubrics_metrics.description: Each petition entry on the page includes Date Received, Petitioners, Related Statutes, Description, and a link to 'Read the petition' (often a PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page consistently presents each petition with those metadata fields so readers can quickly identify who submitted the petition, the statutory basis referenced, a short description of the request, and access the petition document and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Posting does not indicate agency decision
rubrics_metrics.description: The presence of a petition on this page does not indicate an EPA decision to grant or deny the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posting is informational only; it should not be interpreted as acceptance, endorsement, or denial of the petition's merits or requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-on regulatory action subject to outreach and notice-and-comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Any regulatory action that follows as a result of a petition for rulemaking would still be shaped by the typical outreach used by the agency to gather stakeholder input, and is still subject to any applicable notice and comment requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if a petition leads to regulatory activity, the agency will follow standard procedures (e.g., stakeholder outreach, notice-and-comment rulemaking) before issuing final rules; petitioners should not assume immediate regulatory change without those processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing updates and currency note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional petitions will be added on an ongoing basis as they are received or identified; petitions on this page were last updated in November 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page is periodically updated; users should check the page for the latest status and note the 'last updated' timestamp to assess currency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separation of petitions from other EPA offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for rulemaking from other offices are treated separately (navigation links shown for other offices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page is specific to the Office of Air and Radiation; petitions originating from other EPA offices (e.g., Office of Water, Office of Chemical Safety and Pollution Prevention) are maintained on their respective pages or listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and feedback provision
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact Us about Petitions — a point of contact is provided to ask a question, provide feedback, or report a problem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users with questions about the petitions listing or who need to report issues are directed to use the provided 'Contact Us about Petitions' link rather than assuming action from posting alone.
